description: Central source registry. Reference by ID from articles, timeline, and claims. Powers popups and auto-bibliographies.

sources.author: Rasmussen, S.O. et al.
sources.title: A new Greenland ice core chronology for the last glacial termination
sources.summary: Establishes the GICC05 timescale used for precise Younger Dryas onset and termination dating.
sources.reliability: High — ice-core layer counting with quantified uncertainty

sources.author: Various (PNAS consortium)
sources.title: Timing and structure of the Younger Dryas event and its underlying climate dynamics
sources.publication: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.summary: Synthesises multi-proxy timing of YD onset (~12.87 ka) and termination across hemispheres.

sources.author: Dietrich, O. et al.
sources.title: Radiocarbon sequence and architectural phasing at Göbekli Tepe
sources.summary: Primary radiocarbon and stratigraphic work placing Layer III in the mid-10th millennium cal BC.
sources.reliability: High for dates; interpretive elements remain open

sources.author: Schmidt, K. and DAI team
sources.title: Göbekli Tepe excavation reports and synthesis
sources.summary: Foundational excavation data for the site, including architectural documentation of T-pillars and enclosures.

sources.author: Cheng, H. et al.
sources.title: Asian monsoon speleothem records and North Atlantic correlation
sources.summary: High-resolution speleothem δ¹⁸O series that tightly correlate with Greenland ice-core events including the Younger Dryas.

sources.author: Sweatman, M.B.
sources.title: Göbekli Tepe’s carvings and proposed solar / comet calendar interpretations
sources.summary: Interprets pillar iconography as recording a comet impact near the Younger Dryas onset. Contested but widely discussed.

sources.author: Comparative collections (Frazer, Dundes, regional ethnographies)
sources.title: Global flood and deluge narrative catalogues
sources.summary: Document the worldwide distribution and structural parallels of flood traditions.
sources.reliability: Strong for distribution data; causation remains interpretive
